name: SF-VAE (Spherical Folding Variational Autoencoder)
definition: A neural network architecture that encodes 3D Gaussian parameters into a latent space and decodes them using a spherical folding grid to reconstruct the geometry and color of the Gaussians.
summary: SF-VAE is a learning-based initialization method that encodes 3D Gaussian parameters into a latent space and decodes them using a spherical folding grid to reconstruct geometry and color.
